name: На рекорд: збереження загрози
description:
How many puzzles can you solve without making mistakes? Get stars and improve your record.

This Record-breaker is all about maintaining threats. In every puzzle, you have a nice threat on the chessboard but there is also a problem. You have to come up with a smart move to solve that problem, so that you can take a piece in your next move.

Use these steps:

  1. Find the piece you can capture (your threat);
  2. Find the threat of the opponent (capturing, checkmate);
  3. Figure out a clever solution that will save your piece or prevent checkmate and will also maintain your own threat. Think of all the tricks you have learned before;
  4. Capture the enemy piece.

texts: First, save one of your pieces with a counterattack before capturing an enemy piece.
